context.enhanced_by: ChatGPT - Structured for LLM consumption with practice emphasis, assessment type, and language tags

English.prompt: Reading Literature: Generate a short story with characters and a moral. Provide 3 comprehension questions.

Spanish.prompt: Interpersonal: Create a short dialogue in Spanish on a familiar topic with vocab and questions.

Math.prompt: Multiplication: Provide 5 contextual problems using arrays and repeated addition.

Science.prompt: Inquiry: Create an investigation setup with question, materials, and analysis.

English.prompt: Writing Opinion: Provide a prompt where students express an opinion and support it with reasons. Include 3–5 practice questions.

Spanish.prompt: Vocabulary: List themed vocab words with contextual sentences and matching tasks. Include 3–5 practice questions.

Math.prompt: Division: Generate 5 word problems with visual support and explanation.

Science.prompt: Life Science: Generate a text or task on plant/animal traits and habitats. Include 3–5 practice questions.

English.prompt: Reading Info: Generate an informational text with questions about main idea and key details.

Spanish.prompt: Interpretive: Generate a short Spanish paragraph with questions to test comprehension.

Math.prompt: Fractions: Provide a mini-lesson with visual models and fraction comparison. Include 3–5 practice questions.
